data.title: 中野四叶 · 黄昏公园的高空秋千飞跃
data.description: 熔金落日浸染整座街角公园，四叶高高荡起秋千，身体向夕阳长空尽情伸展。飞扬的发带伴随着银铃般欢快的笑声，眼底映着满天绚烂晚霞。
data.action: swinging high on swing, hair flying, joyful open-hearted laugh
data.promptProse: Soaring high into the golden sunset on a park swing, Nakano Yotsuba laughs joyfully with her bright green rabbit-ear ribbon and pleated skirt fluttering in the evening breeze. The orange horizon casts a warm radiant glow across her radiant face.
data.animaCaption: Swinging high toward the golden sunset sky, she laughs with boundless, carefree joy.
